# Flyto2

> Browser automation at machine speed. Record once, replay forever. No coding, no API needed — works on any website. Pause, verify, and resume at any step.

Flyto2 is a no-code automation tool that records your browser actions and replays them at full speed. Unlike other automation tools, Flyto2 lets you pause mid-execution, verify what it's about to do, and resume — you always stay in control. It runs entirely on your computer with no cloud dependency, so your data never leaves your machine.

## What makes Flyto2 different

- **Record & Replay**: Show Flyto2 what to do once. It memorizes every click and keystroke, then replays at machine speed.
- **Pause, Verify, Resume**: Other tools only have "not running" and "finished." Flyto2 lets you pause mid-task, check the state, correct mistakes, and continue exactly where you stopped.
- **No coding required**: If you can click and type, you can use Flyto2. No scripts, no APIs, no Zapier.
- **No API needed**: Works directly in the browser with any website — even sites that have no API or only allow one-at-a-time operations.
- **Works offline**: Runs 100% locally on your computer. No cloud dependency. Same privacy and security on free and paid plans.
- **Split-second timing**: Execute at the exact moment needed — flash sales, reservations, limited slots. Batch 100 items in the time it takes to do 1.

## Who is Flyto2 for

- **Business users** who spend hours on repetitive browser tasks (data entry, form filling, copy-pasting between systems)
- **E-commerce sellers** who need to monitor prices, track inventory, or bulk-update listings
- **Researchers** who collect data from websites that don't offer exports
- **QA testers** who need cross-browser screenshots or link checking
- **Anyone** who does the same browser task more than twice

## Pricing

- **Free**: Core recording and playback, unlimited local usage, MIT-licensed open source, no account or credit card required
- **Pro**: Starting from $9/month (advanced features, coming soon)
- **Enterprise**: Custom pricing, on-premises deployment, RBAC, audit logging, dedicated support
- **Cloud (SaaS)**: Team collaboration, shared workflows (coming soon, waitlist available)

All paid plans include a 30-day money-back guarantee. Discounts available for students, educators, non-profits, and teams (contact sales@flyto2.com).

## Platforms

- Windows, macOS (Intel + Apple Silicon M1–M4), Linux
- CLI via PyPI (Python 3.9+, MIT license)
- WebAssembly module
- Node.js package
- Desktop app (coming soon — visual workflow builder, 250+ built-in modules)
- Self-hosted Docker deployment for enterprise

## Templates (101+ free)

Pre-built automation templates, all free, no coding required:

- **Web scraping**: LinkedIn jobs, Google Maps reviews, social media profiles, restaurant menus
- **Price monitoring**: Amazon tracker, eBay tracker, flight prices, crypto alerts, multi-site comparison
- **Website health**: Broken link checker, uptime monitor, SSL certificate monitor, security headers check
- **Data conversion**: CSV↔JSON, XML→JSON, merge CSV files
- **Content**: Webpage to PDF, website screenshots, cross-browser screenshots, bulk image resize
- **Notifications**: Price drop alerts, weather to Slack, Telegram alerts, exchange rate alerts
- **Forms & login**: Auto-login, bulk form submission, auto-fill job applications, cookie consent dismiss

Full template list: [Templates](https://flyto2.com/templates.html)

## Developer tools

Flyto2 Indexer is an MCP server (Model Context Protocol) providing code intelligence for AI tools:

- Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and any MCP client
- 25 MCP tools: symbol lookup, fulltext search, edit impact preview, test file finder, API tracking, and more
- Cross-project API tracking — know which repos break when you change a shared function
- Zero external dependencies

| Pause & resume mid-task | Yes | No | No | Limited |
| Works without API | Yes | Yes | No | Partial |
| Runs offline / locally | Yes | Yes | No | Partial |

| Browser automation | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
